definitions.gloss: reverse order; inverted sequence; backward order
definitions.explanation: An arrangement or sequence that is the opposite of the usual or expected order. Used when describing things presented from last to first, from newest to oldest, or from Z to A.

examples.japanese: {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
⟦アルファベット→アルファベット：10709_arufabetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧。

⟦ファイル→ファイル：05280_fairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日付|ひづけ}→日付：03706_hizuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べ{替|か}えたら→並べ替える：25340_narabekaeru⟧、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧もの⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: When I re-sorted the files in reverse chronological order, the newest one appeared at the top.

notes:
Combines ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (reverse, opposite) and ⟦{順|じゅん}→順：03342_jun⟧ (order, sequence). A clean compound where the two characters have opposite meanings, producing a word that means the inversion of the normal order.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange in reverse order
- {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧: to display in reverse order
- {時系列|じけいれつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}: reverse chronological order
- {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん}ソート: reverse sort

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧: order, turn — the normal order or sequence
- ⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧: reverse, opposite — broader; can describe any reversal, not just of sequence
- {降順|こうじゅん}: descending order — a technical term (e.g., in databases), while {逆順|ぎゃくじゅん} is more general
- {昇順|しょうじゅん}: ascending order — the opposite of {降順|こうじゅん}
